about_short_description.short_description: Ledger Investing is an online marketplace powering interactions between investors and insurance carriers.

product.name: Casualty Insurance-Linked Securities (ILS) Marketplace
product.description: A marketplace connecting insurers, reinsurers, MGAs, and fronting carriers with institutional capital for casualty insurance risk transactions.

product.name: Casualty ILS Broking and Placement
product.description: Brokerage and placement services for casualty insurance-linked securities, including sourcing risks, arranging investors, and placing structured insurance transactions.

product.name: Casualty ILS Structuring and Advisory
product.description: Advisory and structuring services that convert casualty insurance risk and premium cash flows into capital-market and reinsurance solutions.

product.name: Ledger Capital Markets
product.description: A securities broker-dealer and placement agent focused on insurance structured finance, including casualty ILS distribution and transaction execution.

product.name: Casualty ILS Asset Management
product.description: Investment management for casualty insurance-linked securities, including dedicated funds and managed exposure to insurance risk portfolios.

identifier.value: Secondary Trading and Distribution of Casualty ILS

product.name: Secondary Trading and Distribution of Casualty ILS
product.description: Distribution and secondary-market services for transferring and placing existing casualty insurance-linked securities and related insurance risk positions.
